observation.visible_scene: A brightly lit dance studio with a full-height mirror wall on the right and a plain white wall on the left. A woman stands with her back to the camera, wearing a sleeveless dark floral top, a white tiered skirt over shorts, white socks and sneakers; her mirrored reflection faces the viewer. Ceiling track lights, a hanging curtain and wall outlets remain fixed in the background.
visible_changes: At the start the dancer's hands are bent up near the sides of her head; over the first few frames they rise and come together above her head, then open upward.
From roughly t=0.2s onward the arms extend high and progressively spread outward and downward, moving from vertical toward a wide horizontal 'T' position by about t=0.7-1.0s.
In the final frames (t=1.1-1.34s) the arms continue lowering from horizontal toward the sides/hips with elbows bending, so the excerpt ends mid-descent rather than at a rest pose.
The mirrored reflection reproduces the same arm trajectory facing forward, confirming it is a reflection of the single dancer, not a second person.
The lower-body stance stays essentially constant throughout: feet apart, left heel raised off the floor, right foot planted, with only minor body sway.
The camera and background are stationary; the apparent changes are the dancer's arm motion, not camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: The motion preceding the hands-at-head pose and the motion following the arm lowering are not shown; this is a cropped middle segment of a longer sequence.
Whether the arm sweep is part of a larger dance routine and what the next step is remain unseen.
uncertain_details: Hand shapes and exact positions are partly obscured by motion blur in several frames.
Any subtle hip/torso rotation is hard to distinguish from the dominant arm movement.
